summary: Iteration 10 (Phase 2: Portfolio P&L + PDF Export + Telegram) — backend + frontend tested. Backend pytest: 12/12 PASS in 5.87s. Frontend Playwright: all critical flows pass — /portfolio renders add-position-form + 4 metric cards + positions table with live yfinance prices (AAPL $266.17, MSFT $424.16); add-position submit succeeds end-to-end; /settings renders settings-page + telegram-module + telegram-not-configured banner correctly; /analysis/TSLA renders download-pdf-button which initiates a real PDF blob download (suggested filename neulab-tsla-49238ee6.pdf). Cross-user PDF access correctly returns 404 (owner-only enforced). Telegram /link returns 503 'not configured' as expected when TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN empty. AVOIDED: /api/billing/* (PAYPAL_ENV=live) and any LLM analysis endpoints.

issues: Purchase-date field uses the browser's native HTML5 date input (mm/dd/yyyy placeholder visible) instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover component used elsewhere in the app. This breaks design consistency, locks date format to user-locale (US-only mm/dd/yyyy), and isn't theme-able (renders a default OS picker on click). Recommend swapping to <Popover><Calendar/></Popover> for visual + interaction parity.

action_items: (LOW · design) Replace native HTML5 date input on PortfolioPage AddPosition form with shadcn Calendar inside a Popover, matching app design system.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/portfolio.py — Clean CRUD. Validates ticker via live get_quote() before insert (correctly returns 404 for unknown symbols). Pydantic Field(gt=0) on shares/avg_cost gives proper 422s. user_id scoping is applied on all reads/updates/deletes, and _id is excluded from projections. Good.

routers/portfolio.py:114 — total_day_change_pct math: prev_total = total_market_value - total_day_change. This correctly back-computes yesterday's portfolio MV but only includes positions where BOTH price AND prev_close were available. If some positions are missing prev_close (e.g. fresh IPO), they are silently dropped from day_change but still counted in total_market_value — could yield a misleading prev_total. Worth a comment or guard.

routers/portfolio.py:172-176 — purchase_date validation in update_position is reachable AFTER `if not updates: return` only if purchase_date present; ordering is fine but slightly confusing. Consider moving validation before the dict comprehension.

routers/analysis.py:141-159 — PDF endpoint is owner-scoped via {id, user_id}; cross-user access correctly returns 404 (verified). StreamingResponse with explicit Content-Disposition attachment + filename is correct. PDF byte size in test was ~13KB (>5KB threshold met).

services/pdf.py — Well-structured reportlab usage. Brand colors centralized as constants. Handles missing fields gracefully (uses '—' placeholder). Disclaimer footer present. PageBreak before candlestick section avoids cramped pages. Good.

services/telegram.py — is_configured() correctly gates ALL bot calls (link, poll, sendMessage). poll_and_link uses a persistent updates_offset cursor in db.settings — survives restarts and avoids duplicate processing. send_alert_to_user is fire-and-forget compatible (no exceptions thrown for unlinked users — returns False). Auto-linking by 6-digit code in '/start <code>' or bare '<code>' is a great UX. Good.

routers/telegram.py — /link returns 503 (Service Unavailable) when not configured — this is semantically correct (the upstream Telegram bot service isn't ready). Some teams prefer 501 (Not Implemented) for 'feature disabled', but 503 is fine. /unlink intentionally always 200s with {unlinked:bool} — allows idempotent client UX.
Backward-compat: GET /api/portfolio on a never-touched user correctly returns the zeroed shape with empty positions[], matching the spec.

Frontend integration: download-pdf-button uses fetch() with Bearer token + Blob URL approach (since native <a download> can't send auth headers cross-origin). Verified live: file downloads as 'neulab-tsla-49238ee6.pdf'.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 4 critical flows verified: portfolio render+CRUD, settings telegram banner, analysis report PDF download, navigation links present)
